description: We are a team of passionate BTech 1st-year CSE students interested in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, coding, and innovation. We aim to explore AI-driven solutions to real-world challenges through creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving. We are looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills or interest in AI/ML, Python, programming, research, data analysis, and presentation who are eager to learn and build impactful solutions together.
summary:
Robotics is a branch of engineering and technology that deals with the design, construction, programming, operation, and application of robots.
A robot is a programmable machine that can perform tasks automatically or with human assistance.
Robotics combines several fields:
Computer Science
Electronics
Mechanical Engineering
Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Mathematics
Programming
